decisions.reason: Because Product A has kept a dedicated page over several years, its performance likely meets or exceeds the firm's aspiration level, and organizational slack makes dropping unlikely.
Product B's dedicated page similarly indicates performance above aspirations, so the firm will keep it and the drop probability is low.

Product C's mere mention suggests performance may be closer to the aspiration threshold, but as the firm has slack and no clear shortfall triggered problemistic search, it will keep it with a 25% drop probability.
Product F's continued mention and niche market imply acceptable performance relative to aspirations, and slack allows keeping it, giving a 20% probability of dropping.
